## What and why

<!-- What does this change do, and why is it needed? Link the issue: "Closes #123". -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Breaking change (input, output or behaviour change; migration notes in the changelog)
- [ ] Documentation or tooling only

## Checklist

- [ ] `fmt`, `validate` and `tflint` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated (`tofu test` / `terraform test`)
- [ ] README reference regenerated (`terraform-docs .`)
- [ ] Examples updated if the interface changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased*
- [ ] No state, plan, `*.tfvars`, credentials or real infrastructure details in the diff
- [ ] An ADR is added or updated for design changes
